uncertain_sources: The spoken recurrence estimate omits a microscopic time unit. The chapter restores a correlation-time prefactor and treats two to the N as the dimensionless scale.
The lecture alternates between phase space and configuration space. The chapter uses full phase space for the theorem and cancels common momentum factors in the positional volume ratio.
The shorthand probability e to the minus equilibrium entropy suppresses the entropy of the target macrostate. The chapter uses the entropy deficit Delta S.
The spoken room-particle estimate of ten to the thirtieth is intentionally rough. The chapter preserves that scale while noting the ordinary atmospheric estimate near ten to the twenty-seventh.
The cosmological recurrence and Boltzmann-brain discussion is heuristic. The chapter does not promote it into a complete measure theory.
The magnetization definition is temporarily written with an extra mu H and then corrected. The chapter uses only the corrected dimensionless definition.
The energy convention makes positive H favor the state called down. The chapter keeps that convention and explains the resulting minus sign in magnetization.
The classroom history incorrectly says Ising obtained the wrong one-dimensional answer and mispronounces Kramers. The chapter preserves the narrative transition but corrects the historical record.
The intuitive tiny-field account of spontaneous symmetry breaking suppresses finite-size ensemble symmetry. The chapter states the relevant thermodynamic-limit order.
